title: The Last Call • Luxury Speakeasy • Rooftop Pool
description:
🥃 Welcome to The Last Call, Nashville’s luxury speakeasy-inspired retreat designed for guests who appreciate elevated style, unforgettable nights, and boutique hotel comfort.

Located minutes from Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, City Winery, this top-floor designer condo blends rich textures, custom décor, and trendy nightlife vibes into one unforgettable stay.

Whether it’s a bday, group-chat’ trip, couples getaway, concert weekend… The stay everyone wishes they booked.

Permit #T2022056644

The space
✔ Designer Speakeasy Interior

✔ Luxury King Suite

✔ Glam Vanity Lounge

✔ Curated Espresso Bar

✔ Smart Home Technology

✔ Complimentary Parking

✔ Top Floor City Views

✔ Resort-Style Saltwater Pool

✔ Luxury Fitness Center

✔ High-Speed WiFi

✔ 55”+ Smart TV

✔ Premium Bedding

Every room has been intentionally designed to feel like stepping inside a private members club—with dramatic black finishes, warm ambient lighting, rich velvet accents, curated artwork, and elevated luxury around every corner.

Guest access
As our guest at The Last Call | A Private Stay, you’ll enjoy exclusive access to premium community amenities:

• Complimentary Reserved Parking
• Rooftop Sky Lounge with Downtown Views
• Resort-Style Saltwater Pool
• Private Pool Cabanas
• Luxury Fitness Center
• Resident Billiards Lounge
• Outdoor Grilling Stations
• Fire Pit Lounge
• Outdoor Cocktail Bar & Social Spaces

Please enjoy all community amenities respectfully and help us preserve the elevated experience for every guest. Welcome to The Last Call—where every stay deserves one more unforgettable night.
